definitions.explanation: Describes someone who shows great interest and energy toward something.
Describes serious commitment to an activity or cause.

notes:
{熱心|ねっしん} is a na-adjective meaning 'enthusiastic' or 'devoted.'

Forms:
- Adverbial: {熱心|ねっしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- Modifier: {熱心|ねっしん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun

Conjugation:
- Negative: {熱心|ねっしん}⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {熱心|ねっしん}じゃ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- Te-form: {熱心|ねっしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧
- Past: {熱心|ねっしん}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧

Common patterns:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{熱心|ねっしん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: to be enthusiastic about ~
- {熱心|ねっしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do ~ enthusiastically
- {熱心|ねっしん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun: enthusiastic/dedicated [noun]

Similar words:
- {熱心|ねっしん} vs. ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧: ⟦{一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい}→一生懸命：01280_isshoukenmei⟧ emphasizes effort; {熱心|ねっしん} emphasizes enthusiasm/interest.
- {熱心|ねっしん} vs. ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧: ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧ means serious/diligent; {熱心|ねっしん} implies passionate interest.
